subject: Animation
title: Japanese Animation's Global Dominance
description: A quick win: understand Japanese Animation's Global Dominance.

hook.text: Japan's anime industry is worth over $25 billion and influences animation styles across every continent.

buildup.text: Streaming platforms like Crunchyroll made anime globally accessible, removing the old barriers of import and dubbing.

discovery.text: Demon Slayer's 2020 film earned $500 million, briefly becoming the highest-grossing film in Japanese history.

twist.text: Despite massive revenue, Japanese animators are notoriously underpaid, often earning less than minimum wage.

climax.text: Japan dominates global animation culturally but faces a labor crisis that threatens its own industry's future.

punchline.text: The world's most profitable animation industry can't afford to pay its artists.

quiz.question: What paradox faces Japan's animation industry?
options: It has too many studios and not enough viewers
Despite generating over $25 billion, many Japanese animators earn less than minimum wage
